component.name: Stormware Pohoda Integration Documentation
component.summary: English HTML documentation of the Pohoda XML, mServer and SQL interfaces

description.p: Sphinx-generated HTML documentation of the integration interfaces of the Stormware Pohoda accounting system: XML import/export (dataPack, XSD), mServer (HTTP) and the SQL database structure. Compiled from the official stormware.cz documentation and the XSD schemas.
